admission_regulation.title: Studien- und Prüfungsordnung für den Master-Studiengang Healthy und Sustainable Buildings (HSB) an der Technischen Hochschule Deggendorf
admission_regulation.version: vom 15. März 2022, in Kraft mit Wirkung zum 15.03.2022, gilt für Studienbeginn ab Sommersemester 2022 (latest version found; no amendment located)

accepted_degree_fields.note: SPO § 3: first degree (grundständiges Studium) of at least 180 ECTS in civil and environmental engineering (Bau- und Umweltingenieurwesen) or architecture, or an equivalent degree; the examination committee decides on equivalence. Program page: 'civil or environmental engineering, or architecture'.

grade_requirement.note: No minimum overall grade. The Bachelor thesis grade only gives points in the aptitude procedure (see subsequent_selection_criteria_display); no conversion method for foreign grades is stated.

subject_credit_requirements.note: The SPO sets no subject-credit minimums; access is by degree field (civil/environmental engineering, architecture or equivalent) plus the aptitude procedure.

conditional_admission.mechanism: SPO 2022 contains no Auflagen rule for missing subject knowledge; suitability is tested in the aptitude procedure (§ 4).

descriptive_notes: Aptitude assessment procedure (Eignungsfeststellungsverfahren, SPO § 4), 100 points: (a) Bachelor thesis grade max 30 (1.0-1.7 = 30, 1.8-2.5 = 15, 'ab 2,5' = 0); (b) professional experience max 10 (2 years or more = 10, 1-2 years = 5); (c) written test max 30 (60 minutes, may be online), passed with at least 20; (d) interview max 30 (max 20 minutes, may be virtual: subject discussion 15, motivation 5, expectations 5, career relevance 5), passed with at least 20.
Invitation to the interview requires at least 50 of the 70 points from (a)+(b)+(c); aptitude is established with at least 70 of 100 points in total.
The examination committee may waive the interview for degrees with grade 2.0 or better ('überdurchschnittlich').
Failed procedure may be repeated once, at the following year's date; no further repetition.

SPO 2022 says the procedure is held once a year in the winter semester for the following summer semester; current program and application pages say study start is winter semester with application 15.04.-15.07. (conflict, see notes).

language_english.note: SPO § 3: English at level B2. THD ECRI language requirements PDF, row Healthy and Sustainable Buildings (M.Eng.): IELTS 'In jedem Teilbereich sind 5,5 - 6,5 Punkte zu erreichen' (5.5-6.5 in each section, the B2 band; stored minimum 5.5 per section; confirmed by Koushik from the PDF, 10.10.2026). IELTS Academic or General accepted (not IELTS Indicator); only TOEFL iBT accepted, no Home Editions; certificates not older than 2 years.

language_german.due: during studies (by end of studies); not an admission requirement

aps_certificate.note: THD application page: APS certificate required for applicants from China, India and Vietnam. The same page says Indian Master's applicants must prove a Digital Master Test (dMAT) from summer semester 2027 for 'zahlreiche Studiengänge' (programmes not listed; not confirmed for HSB).

accepted_degree_fields.note: ZO § 2(1): bachelor in a subject-suitable programme (foreign degrees per anabin); suitable 'in der Regel' civil engineering, civil and environmental engineering and related degrees with the credit minimums below. grade_requirement.note: No minimum grade. If applicants exceed places, ranking by final/average grade, ties by lot (ZO § 4). items.raw_label: ZO § 2(1): 18 LP Mathematik für Ingenieurwissenschaften (incl. probability/statistics/data analysis)
ZO § 2(1): 12 LP Informatik/Programmierung
ZO § 2(1): 18 LP naturwissenschaftliche Grundlagen (incl. physics, biology, chemistry, fluid mechanics, thermodynamics)
ZO § 2(1) Route A: at least 30 LP water or environmental engineering (incl. hydrology, water management, urban water management, fluid mechanics, process engineering, sustainability)

subject_credit_requirements.note: ROUTE A (ZO § 2(1)): 30 LP water/environmental engineering. ZO § 2(1) minimums. Water/environment: 30 LP, or 20 LP if the bachelor thesis is in water engineering. DECISION (Koushik 24.10.2026): fluid mechanics (Strömungsmechanik) is listed in BOTH the natural-sciences and the water/environment groups and the ZO has no non-overlap clause → the same course counts toward both items. conditional_admission.mechanism: ZO § 2(1): suitability can be granted with a Nebenbestimmung to make up missing modules within two semesters; enrolment lapses if proof is not given within one year (§ 4(4)). No cap stated.

descriptive_notes: ROUTE A (ZO § 2(1)): 30 LP water/environmental engineering.

If applicants exceed places: ranking by grade, ties by lot (ZO § 4).
Unfinished bachelor: apply with at least 150 LP; degree by 15 April (ZO § 2(2), § 4(4)).
